name: Multidirectional Occlusion Shading
definition: A novel technique that simulates directional light scattering for realistic interactive volume rendering by extending the directional occlusion shading model to allow arbitrary light source positioning within the hemisphere defined by the view vector, using elliptic footprints instead of symmetric spherical ones.
summary: Multidirectional Occlusion Shading is an interactive volume rendering technique that simulates soft shadows using tilted cone-shaped phase functions, allowing arbitrary light positioning unlike its predecessor.
